title: Chapter 1206
text:
"The Coristi civilization has sent an unusual report, claiming that two unfamiliar Supreme Champions have violated the ban and appeared out of thin air in the capital of Emperor Tuo Province. After a fierce battle, the two fled into the stars and disappeared without a trace … This is the video they recorded."

The huge conference room was filled with people, all watching the video on the virtual screen seriously. The video was the scene of Han Xiao and Kasuyi fighting the guards of Tito Province.

The video did not last long, and it soon ended with the shocking slash of the Mechanical Deity.

The screen turned black, and the room was silent for a while. Then, discussions broke out.

"It's confirmed. These two are indeed Supreme Beings."

"There's no information about them in the archives. Their origins are unknown, their identities are unknown, and their races are unknown. There are no recorded activity reports."

"That's strange. Even in our Superpower Security Department, with the strength of these two people, they should be able to form an independent division. Why are such strong people willing to be lonely and unknown in the past?"

"Hmm … they've been hiding their existence. It can only be understood that they have big plans."

"Could it be related to the World Reboot Plan? Otherwise, why would they jump out at a critical time when the entire universe is under martial law?"

"This matter must be treated seriously. We can't allow any factors that might interfere with the World Reboot Plan to exist."

At this time, an upper echelon who seemed to be a department leader knocked on the table, interrupting everyone's discussion, and said in an unquestionable tone,

"This matter will be handed over to the Fifth, Seventh, and Eleventh Divisions to deal with. Please be sure to capture these two people and carefully investigate their origins."

In the room, three upper echelons of different races stood up and nodded slightly, indicating that they had accepted the mission.

The department leader nodded and slowly said, "This is a very special time. We don't have time to chase and escape with them. It's best to end this quickly. I approve the use of the Universal Treasure 'Positioning Star Map' to lock onto their coordinates."

Hearing this, everyone present smiled faintly.

The 'Positioning Star Map' was an important trump card of their Superpower Security Department. It was a Universal Treasure whose formation was unknown. A complete star map was stored inside, and as long as the target's information was input, they could locate the target's coordinates in space in real time.

All fugitives had nowhere to hide in front of this tool!

…

Several days later.

Han Xiao had transformed the underground of a certain gray, desolate planet into a temporary base. Automatic mining devices went deep into the veins to collect all kinds of ores and resources, which were then transported to the material processing and refining area through assembly lines, where they were made into various types of raw materials and then put on the production line.

Due to the shortage of materials, Han Xiao had only assembled a portion of the production line for basic machines. Most of them were gathering and assistant machines to expand the initial production capacity.

In the central control room of the temporary base, Han Xiao sat in a simple quantum field magnifier, surrounded by densely packed virtual screens. Astonishing streams of data were constantly flashing on them. He had been deciphering the basic quantum network coding language of this space for several days.

Kasuyi was sitting on a metal bench nearby, his head leaning back against the rock wall as he watched Han Xiao work in boredom. He had maintained this posture for a long time.

Black Star took care of all the work, and Kasuyi couldn't help at all. He could only wait by the side for the next few days.

At this moment, Han Xiao's eyelids twitched. He slowly opened his eyes and exhaled.

"The deciphering is complete."

Kasuyi was energized, and he quickly sat up straight. "So fast?"

"It's okay. Their basic coding language isn't complicated. As long as we find the entry point, the rest is simple."

Han Xiao waved his hand.

The difficulty of cracking this time was far lower than the Virtual Mutiny Virus. The Domino Virus was a weapon that contained multiple keys. Without a reference target, he could only keep trying. The goal this time was the basic quantum network coding, which had many similarities with the quantum network of the main universe. Moreover, it was open source, so there were many references. Han Xiao had also obtained (Virtual Technology Innovation- Manison), which greatly enhanced his Virtual Technology, making cracking it even easier.

Now that the deciphering was complete, his Virtual Technology methods could be used normally here.

"Then what are you waiting for? Use your invincible Virtual Intrusion to collect information." Kasuyi could not wait.

"Okay."

Han Xiao nodded, closed his eyes, and sank into the quantum network vision to collect information on this space on a large scale.

Kasuyi paced back and forth more than ten times before he finally saw Han Xiao open his eyes again. He immediately asked, "How is it? What did you find?"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's expression became extremely strange.

He took a deep breath, and the next moment, he suddenly burst out, grabbed Kasuyi's neck with both hands, and shook him repeatedly while gnashing his teeth.

"Damn you! Where the hell did you bring me to? "

Kasuyi's head was shaken so hard that it left afterimages.

"W-What do you mean?"

"See for yourself!"

Han Xiao released his hand, opened a virtual screen, and displayed all the information he had collected.

Kasuyi hurriedly went forward to browse, and his eyes slowly widened. Disbelief gradually appeared on his face.

"This … How is this possible?"

Kasuyi subconsciously took two steps back, his face full of disbelief.

This information was not top-secret, and it was the basic information that Han Xiao had collected. However, the content exceeded their expectations.

The area of this secondary dimension was actually vaster than the explored universe! There were a total of thirty-three Star Fields, six to seven hundred Star Clusters, and countless civilizations at all levels!

The universe was ruled by a top civilization alliance called the Celestial Star Alliance. Just from the introduction, it was obviously stronger than the three Universal Civilizations, and its history was even longer. Even the oldest of the three Universal Civilizations was only a fraction of the Celestial Star Alliance's civilization.

There were also five Super systems here: machinery, psychic, pugilist, Esper, and magic. However, they called energy 'origin energy', and the names for each grade were completely different. The 'Saint Grade' they called corresponded to the Beyond Grade A, and the 'Supreme Grade' corresponded to the peak Beyond Grade A.

In terms of individual strength, this secondary dimension was also unbelievably strong. According to the data, there were nearly ten thousand 'Saint Grade' experts recorded in the universe! The number of Beyond Grade As was close to ten thousand, and there were more than a hundred peak Beyond Grade As! The first reaction of the two was that it was impossible!

What kind of concept was this? Although the lifespan of a Beyond Grade A was long, most of them would still die of old age. To accumulate nearly ten thousand living Beyond Grade As, how long had this secondary dimension existed?

The two originally thought that this secondary dimension was at most a secondary dimension universe that had coincidentally developed, but they did not expect that there seemed to be a civilization many times stronger than the three Universal Civilizations.

"Black Star, are you joking with me? You made this information up, right? "Kasuyi was shocked.

"Why would I joke with you at a time like this? This information was all taken from the internet. It's all the most basic information. "

Han Xiao frowned. When he first saw this information online, he also doubted its authenticity. However, after repeated confirmation, he found that it was all true.

Could this secondary dimension really be a place stronger than the explored universe? The Celestial Star Alliance was even stronger than the three Universal Civilizations? This was too exaggerated! There was actually such a monster in the secondary dimension?

Or was this really an unexplored area of the main universe?

Then, what did Kasuyi and Manison do when they came here in his previous life? How did they get back?!

Han Xiao's brain worked quickly. The information in his previous life was limited, so he did not know what was going on.

Kasuyi had yet to recover from his shock and muttered to himself, "If the civilization in this secondary dimension runs out, then …"

Hearing this, Han Xiao's eyes suddenly flashed, and he hurriedly went online again, intending to search for this universe's views on the secondary dimensions. If the Celestial Star Alliance really existed in the secondary dimensions, then it was impossible that they had not explored the outside world.

Very soon, Han Xiao found what he was looking for. However, the result of the search shocked him once again.

There were no secondary dimensions in this universe!

There was no division between the 'main universe' and the 'secondary dimension'!

What they had was a single universe, and they could not explore any 'outside world' at all. They knew nothing about the Space Lice and the 'Supreme Guardian' outside the secondary dimensions.

Strange!

Too strange!

Han Xiao's curiosity grew stronger.

"By the way, when we first came in, those six Beyond Grade As seemed to have said something about the entire universe being under martial law. Let's see what's going on …"

As he thought of this, Han Xiao hurriedly typed in the keywords and searched on the Internet. Very soon, his view was filled with a term.

'World Reboot Plan'!

The announcement said that this was a universal-level plan carried out by the Celestial Star Alliance. This was a special insurance measure to prevent an unsolvable disaster in the future.

The information Han Xiao found was all announcements and news, so he could only understand the general idea. It seemed that the Celestial Star Alliance was using a new Information Form technology to copy the information of the entire universe and use it as a tinder library. If an unsolvable disaster occurred in the future, the tinder library would be used as a blueprint to reboot the world.

The copying process was a period of martial law in the entire universe. The Celestial Star Alliance requested everyone to stay in one place and not move around to prevent interfering with the construction of the tinder library. Therefore, the interstellar space was quite deserted, and there were almost no spaceships to be seen.

As for the specific details of the plan, the Celestial Star Alliance did not disclose it to the public, so Han Xiao did not know.

"Why do I feel that this plan is not the so-called insurance …"

Han Xiao muttered to himself. Seeing that Kasuyi was still in a daze, he went up and knocked him on the head.

"What do we do now? The size of this space is far beyond our imagination, and your senses are no longer working. You might not be able to find your so-called opportunity even if you spend a few hundred years."

In his opinion, this should be the difficulty of the mission represented by the 4,500 billion experience points.

Kasuyi came back to his senses. His expression was uncertain, and he did not speak for a while.

Seeing his reaction, Han Xiaoxin sighed.

He was fine. After all, his growth system was different, and he knew about the existence of the World Tree. Therefore, although he was shocked, he did not have any other emotions.

However, Old Ke was different. He had spent countless years and finally reached the peak of the explored universe, only to suddenly discover that there was always someone stronger. There were actually hundreds of people at the same level as him. It was normal for his mentality to have problems.

Han Xiao thought for a while before comforting him. "Old Ke, don't be depressed. This secondary dimension has existed for who knows how long. The number of Beyond Grade As has been accumulated over many years. There's nothing to be envious of. If you want to be jealous, you might as well be jealous of me. I only spent a few decades to surpass your hundreds and thousands of years of accumulation. How hateful do you think it is? "

"…" Kasuyi.

Are you really comforting me?

I have a curse, but I don't know if I should say it.

Looking at Kasuyi's constipated expression, Han Xiao was about to continue comforting him when his artificial intelligence suddenly sounded.

"Beep beep! You have received a new message."

"Eh, who could it be at this time …"

Halfway through his sentence, Han Xiao suddenly realized what was going on.

That's right, no one here knows my communication method. Who can contact me?

Han Xiao's expression changed slightly. He opened the quantum network and found that he had received a message out of nowhere. The sender was a bunch of random codes. He operated it for a while, but he was unable to trace the source of the message. The other party did not leave any clues, as though they had appeared out of thin air.

He frowned and opened the message, finding that it contained a set of complicated Mechanic blueprints and a short message.

"Learn this technology as soon as possible, or you will have nowhere to run. If you can get rid of the pursuers, go to a place and wait. I will contact you again. The coordinates are as follows …"

"Who is this?"

Han Xiao wanted to communicate with the other party, but there was no path and he could not reply.

He could only turn around and browse through the blueprints sent by the mysterious person. There was a strange instrument recorded on it that seemed to have some kind of special stealth function. He did not know what kind of detection device it was used to guard against.

"Things seem to be getting more and more interesting …"

Han Xiao's eyes flickered.

From the strange "Supreme Guardian" outside the secondary dimension at the beginning, to the unexpectedly strong Celestial Star Alliance, and now to the mysterious person who had inexplicably contacted him, things were getting more and more confusing. It was as if he had been involved in an unknown storm.

He decided to stay and explore, not only to help Kasuyi or to collect technology, but also to find out the truth of this space. Otherwise, not only him, but the entire explored universe would not be able to sleep and eat in peace.

However, since entering this secondary dimension, the situation was not under his control. He lacked information and could only see what was on the surface. He did not know who to trust.

Ding!

At this moment, a notification popped up on the interface.

You have triggered the S-grade Hidden Mission [Relay Across Iterations]!

This mission is a chain mission. You are currently in the first round.

Requirements for the first round: Get rid of the pursuers and successfully meet up with the mysterious person who sent the message.

Failure Condition: Death of the mysterious person.

Reward: 1,000,000,000 EXP, start of the next round of the mission.

Warning! This mission may have unpredictable effects. Please choose carefully!]
